title: Connect match callables deadline callbacks and recipient publication in emulators
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md, docs/design/SWARM-BRIEF-v0.md, docs/design/RULES-SPEC-v1.md and the listed sourceRefs before editing. The imported Rules Spec v1 is the canonical engine contract; the earlier prototype/T01-T10 interfaces are baseline compatibility, not current gameplay rules. Do not restore approval votes, Repair/Sabotage buttons, Witness or five-node tracks. Preserve original IP and engine independence from Firebase/UI/Node. Edit only ownership; publish APIs only through explicitly owned package entrypoints, preserving baseline exports. Use original synthetic fixtures, scoped tests/lint/typecheck and npm run check. Do not commit, push, open PRs, spawn agents, provision/deploy services, access credentials or alter swarm budget. After G4, register bounded emulator callable routes for start-match,ordinary match intent and host request-advance around A066/A074/A065 alongside lobby callables. Trusted scheduled deadline callbacks use a separate injected server capability,not a public actor override; do not provision a cloud scheduler. Preserve request identity/revision/phase generation,validate server auth/payloads,and publish A067 views through A073 only from confirmed commits. A lost response or projection failure recovers from the idempotency/outbox state without rerunning an action or timeout. Expose the actual complete path for tap-one-player voting,Route/Gate choices,track powers,automatic City Moment/next-round progression and terminal result/spectator views. The online timer continues while a client menu/background is local. Explicit service index wiring publishes only reviewed routes; no live config/deployment. Firebase gate G4 is externally blocked by D-FIREBASE-PROJECT: Sergio must create/provide the project before any Firebase worker, SDK/configuration or provider adapter is implemented. Do not create/configure a project, discover credentials or make live calls. Once that gate is satisfied, this ticket still uses demo/loopback emulators and injected clients only; no project IDs, app config, tokens or service accounts are committed. When configured multiplayer seats include bots, invoke the approved A076 fair bot policy only through a trusted server capability and its A025 recipient/legal-action observation, never a client-supplied bot actor or hidden full-state policy. Bot actions pass through the same revision/idempotency/deadline transaction path; do not implement another bot policy. Complete the matching browser FirebaseAuthority implementation of the published A056 AuthorityPortV1 rather than stopping at server routes. Use A072 pinned SDKs and the owner-provided runtime initialization/emulator configuration only after G4; no project/app configuration or credentials are tracked. Bind invisible verified session context,create/list/join/read/update calls,canonical submit and revisioned recipient subscriptions to the actual emulator callable/read-model endpoints. Decode every incoming view through A056,invoke A035 lifecycle coordination without duplicating client cache authority,and dispose listeners/pending callbacks on room or identity generation changes. Fail explicitly if capability/configuration is unavailable; never substitute fake online rooms or make Firebase a prerequisite for Solo. Browser tests inject SDK transport/auth/subscription seams and verify endpoint/payload mapping,stale-callback suppression and disposal; emulator integration proves the real UI session port reaches the same authoritative service.
acceptance: Authenticated emulator clients can create/start the exact Rules v1 match and submit crew votes,operator choices,powers and host-only advance through real transport.
Server deadline callbacks fill missing eligible actions deterministically and race safely with clients without duplicate revisions/events.
Each committed transition publishes correct phase/private/spectator/result views; stale retries and projection failures cannot restore revoked data.
Integration tests cover unauthorized/early/terminal actions,menu/background continuity,lost responses and permanent Disconnect/Null win with bounded emulator cleanup and no live calls.

The actual browser FirebaseAuthority implements the shared typed port,uses the matching emulator endpoints,strictly decodes recipient views and releases subscriptions on identity/room/dispose; missing live capability leaves Solo usable and never fabricates multiplayer.
